candidate_selection: Exactly121 ADVANCE branches A=prior_gap and B=global_temperature; C did not advance. Same annual saved coefficients, no fit/retune.
progression: Require both anchor and retained equal-seed mean winner NLL differences <0; mean top2/top3 diff<=.0005, ECE diff<=.001 and candidate ECE<.05. Any valid individual hard quality BLOCKED requires REVIEW_REQUIRED. Individual DEFER/CI crossing/sign count is not a veto. Keep every passing candidate without ranking.
limitations: Historical development and121 selection-used full information, not an unused holdout or preweight proof.
Uses exact saved121 joint-fit coefficients; evaluates joint gap adjustment plus new term, not an isolated effect holding original gap coefficient fixed.
Top2/top3 are Harville assembled from corrected win with eps0 and strict consistency; original calibration is not applied twice.
Individual v4 CIs transfer sd_fold .001816 / k_seeds1, conditional on frozen correction coefficients; coefficient-refit, selection and retained-side correction uncertainty not fully covered.
Equal-seed mean losses/quality are not probability ensembles, no mean CI or extra sign/majority threshold; deployment seed42 risks remain visible.
No booster or coefficient fitting, annual confirmation slot, production mutation, or post-result tuning.
